name: Wildberries
verdict: Wildberries sits in РВБ (RVB), the combined Wildberries–Russ company: 65% owned by Tatyana Kim's ООО «Вайлдберриз», 35% by the Russ side's ООО «Стинн». Nothing found.
note: Right-chest sponsor on Dynamo Makhachkala's 2026-27 home shirt (club kit launch, 2026-07-25). Stinn's second half sits in closed fund ЗПИФ «Гало» whose beneficiaries are undisclosed, and a Stinn-into-RVB merger began in April 2026 with the final structure unknown (T-Journal, July 2026). No state body or fund in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 2026-10-03).
